notes.title: 500 Wishlists, already!
notes.notes:
[b]It has only been a short few months, and we've already hit 500 wishlists, nearly 600, on Steam, and I barely even promoted the game![/b]

That's means that over half a [b]thousand[/b] people are excited to see the launch!

Thank you for all of the support so far, and I look forward to getting more content on the store page, as well as releasing the game!

Development has slowed down, as my health has recently taken a decline, but work has started back up again, so stay tuned for more updates!
